content.text: No MFN mechanic exists anywhere in the document — pricing is set purely by each Statement of Work, with no obligation running against Clear Capital.

input.quote: (a) During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: The compensation provisions (§ 3(a)-(c)) set Contractor's fees solely by reference to each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, with a unilateral Contractor rate-change notice right; there is no most-favoured-nation, most-favoured-customer, best-terms, benchmarking or right-to-match mechanic anywhere in the Agreement. Targeted searches for "most favoured/favored", "favorable", "right to match", "other customers/clients" and "exclusive" returned no obligation requiring Clear Capital to extend to RadialSpark any terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers, and §§ 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 contain no such covenant. The single preferred element — no MFN obligation on Customer benefiting Vendor — is therefore satisfied at the preferred level, so no redline is proposed. Noted only in passing (not a deviation under this rule): § 3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice, which is a pricing-stability point for the pricing rule rather than an MFN issue.
